entry.title: VA Extending GI Bill Benefits
entry.content: The VA is extending GI Bill benefits. The Rudisill Supreme Court Decision is allowing additional benefits for certain veterans. As of April 16th, 2024, veterans can get up to a year of additional education benefits if you qualify. Check out the eligibility requirements and application Here.
